meta.name: lcx-report-bug
meta.description: Create a high-signal bug issue or PR in the repo that owns the defect. Use this whenever the user asks to report, file, open, or triage a LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, Codex plugin, or upstream Codex CLI bug, especially when they need source-backed root cause, reproduction steps, fix guidance, and GitHub routing.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 整理代码缺陷,生成带根因和复现步骤的报告并提交到对应仓库
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你用的 Codex 插件或 CLI 出了 bug,想规范地反馈给对应的上游仓库
copy.tagline_en: File code defects as sourced GitHub bug issues with repro steps and correct routing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you hit a bug in a Codex plugin or CLI and need to report it upstream properly

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会调查 LazyCodex 或 Codex CLI 的 bug:拉最新源码、跑最小复现、确认根因,再判断归属仓库,产出一份带复现步骤与修复建议的英文 GitHub issue。
howto.when: 当你要求报告、提交或分诊 LazyCodex、omo-codex、Codex 插件等 bug 时触发,它会接管调查与提交。

say.text: 帮我报一个 LazyCodex 的 bug:安装后插件加载失败
say.note: 会先复现并判断归属哪个仓库

say.text: 先搜下有没有相同的 issue,有就补充新证据评论
say.note: 避免重复提交,改在已有 issue 下留言

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude investigates LazyCodex or Codex CLI bugs: syncs the latest sources, runs a minimal reproduction, confirms the root cause, picks the owning repo, and files an English GitHub issue with steps and fix guidance.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to report, file, or triage a bug in LazyCodex, omo-codex, Codex plugins, or upstream Codex CLI.

say_en.text: Report a LazyCodex bug for me: plugins fail to load after install
say_en.note: Reproduces first, then picks the owning repo

say_en.text: This Codex CLI bug reproduces on clean upstream, file it in openai/codex
say_en.note: Files an issue; a PR only if a fix exists

say_en.text: Search for an existing issue first, comment with new evidence if found
